title: Kusikiliza na Kujibu (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a mazungumzo.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short mazungumzo on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.ask: Mazungumzo yataendelea baada ya jibu lako?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu kikamilifu na umrudishie mwenzako swali.

checks.question: Rafiki anakuuliza: "Unafanyaje kudumisha usafi wako?" Jibu lipi linaendeleza mazungumzo?
checks.answer: Ninaoga kila siku na kufua nguo zangu. Wewe je?

checks.question: Mwenzako bado anazungumza na una jambo la kusema. Ufanye nini?
